challenge.better_approach: Sweep every spawn site at once in one ticket: rejected, each site owns its own component and proof (RULE 1); a per-site ticket keeps a red local.
challenge.hidden_assumption: That the site's child is a console python on Windows: read from source and the 2026-11-23 EnumWindows run on pulse.py, not yet measured on this exact path, so the proof reds first or the ticket is wrong.
challenge.prior_art: Checked in-house: 8c829d9b38b8 (the heartbeat's pulse spawn) and 96cf285e299b (background_python is pythonw on nt) are the same shape; windowless_spawn.background_pythonw is the published helper this ticket calls.
challenge.real_collision: None for the windowless part. None.

answers.falsifier: on Windows ensure() on a silent scratch port starts a listener tree holding no python.exe, no conhost.exe and no visible console window; with the fix reverted the proof reds.
answers.from_idea: none, because it is the sweep the orchestrator ordered under 96cf285e299b (CairnCommons/tickets/96cf285e299b-*.json) after ticket 8c829d9b38b8 built the first of this shape
answers.how: pulse.ensure defaults its python to windowless_spawn.background_pythonw() instead of sys.executable (an explicit python argument still wins); a red-first proof starts the listener on a scratch port and reads the spawned tree and the visible ConsoleWindowClass windows with EnumWindows.
answers.traces_to: Law 3 and Law 8 (measured, with a proof a hollow build could not pass); outline 10.3.2.1; Akien 2026-11-23 via the orchestrator: akiendell is still throwing up windows as it goes.
answers.what: On Windows the web server's pulse starts the listener through background_pythonw, so a silent port 80 never opens a console window; off Windows the argv is unchanged.

bullets.text: Measured 2026-11-23: the visible console windows on akiendell were venv python launchers spawned detached; this site has the same shape in source.
